title: profile
description: Read-only MCP server for Mark Siazon's professional profile: projects, FAQ, proof, availability.
summary: Read-only MCP server for Mark Siazon's professional profile: projects, FAQ, proof, availability.
offersHint: Read-only MCP server for Mark Siazon's professional profile: projects, FAQ, proof, availability. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.marksiazon.dev/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_profile_summary
toolsPreview.description: Profile summary: entity (name, canonical @id, sameAs), availability, and machine-readable pointers.

toolsPreview.name: list_projects
toolsPreview.description: List portfolio projects. Optional filters combine with AND and match case-insensitively; unknown values yield an empty list. Tags are Title Case display strings like "AI Workflow", "Next.js"; matching is case-insensitive so "web3" matches "Web3".

toolsPreview.name: get_project
toolsPreview.description: Full indexed detail for one project by slug, including canonical URL, links, and proof count.

toolsPreview.name: search_faq
toolsPreview.description: Case-insensitive substring search over the consolidated FAQ (question + answer).

toolsPreview.name: get_proof
toolsPreview.description: Verification proof: claim gates, or per-project proof links when a slug is given. Unknown slugs return an error.

toolsPreview.name: get_availability
toolsPreview.description: Current availability, work scope, and the contact boundary (no raw email is published).
